axiora.inlineCompletion.enabled.markdownDescription: Show AI ghost-text suggestions while you type. Press `Tab` to accept, `Esc` to dismiss. Uses the model in `#axiora.inlineCompletion.model#` — no Copilot account needed.

axiora.inlineCompletion.model.markdownDescription:
Fill-in-the-middle model for inline suggestions, served by `#axiora.ai.provider#`.

Examples: `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` (Ollama), `codestral-latest`, `cohere/north-mini-code:free` (OpenRouter).

axiora.inlineCompletion.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Longest suggestion, in tokens. `32`–`64` keeps suggestions to a line or two; `256` allows whole blocks.

axiora.inlineCompletion.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before asking the model. Lower feels snappier; higher saves requests on paid providers.

axiora.nextEdit.enabled.markdownDescription: After you rename a word, suggest the same change at its next occurrence. Press `Tab` to jump and apply.

axiora.keymap.markdownDescription: Built-in key bindings — no extension needed. Switch any time from the Command Palette with **Axiora: Choose Keymap...**.
enumDescriptions: Standard Axiora Code shortcuts.
Modal editing: Normal, Insert and Visual modes with motions, operators and text objects.
Emacs bindings: `Ctrl+A`/`Ctrl+E`, kill ring, mark, `Ctrl+X` prefixes.

axiora.editorconfig.enabled.markdownDescription: Apply [`.editorconfig`](https://editorconfig.org) rules — indentation, line endings, trailing whitespace and final newline — without installing an extension.

axiora.editor.typewriterMode.markdownDescription: Keep the line you are typing vertically centered, like a typewriter. Toggle with **View: Toggle Typewriter Mode**.

axiora.lsp.autoInstall.markdownDescription: What to do when you open a file whose language server Axiora can manage (Python, Bash, YAML, Dockerfile, Go, Rust, C/C++, Lua, Java, Kotlin, Terraform, R…). Manage servers with **Language Servers: Manage...**.
enumDescriptions: Offer to download and start the server the first time it is needed.
Download and start servers silently.
Never download servers; only use ones already on your PATH.

axiora.lsp.disabled.markdownDescription: Server ids that are never started automatically, e.g. `["pyright", "clangd"]`.

axiora.lsp.initializationOptions.markdownDescription:
Per-server `initializationOptions`, keyed by server id.

Example: `{ "gopls": { "staticcheck": true } }`

axiora.inspections.enabled.markdownDescription: Built-in Axiora inspections with quick fixes for JavaScript, TypeScript and Python (unused code, risky patterns, simple bugs).

axiora.chat.defaultParticipant.markdownDescription: Answer plain chat messages with Axiora — no need to type `@axiora`. Turn off to send plain messages to another installed assistant instead. Past chats: **Axiora: Past Conversations**.

axiora.agent.tools.markdownDescription: Let `@axiora` call tools on its own: web search and page reading, a real browser, office files and charts, images, screenshots and message drafts. Destructive tools always follow `#axiora.approval.mode#`.

axiora.web.readPages.markdownDescription: How many of the top results `/web` opens and reads in full before answering. `0` uses snippets only.

axiora.agents.concurrency.markdownDescription: How many subagents `/parallel` runs at the same time. Raise it for fast local models; lower it for rate-limited providers.

axiora.context.repoMap.markdownDescription: Include a compact map of the repository (files and top-level symbols) in `@axiora` prompts. Files matching `.axioraignore` are skipped.

axiora.context.fastContext.markdownDescription: Find the code most relevant to each prompt by keyword search and add it to the context.

axiora.context.liveActions.markdownDescription: Include what you are doing right now — active file, recent edits, terminal commands and errors — so answers match your current task.

axiora.context.extraRepos.markdownDescription: Other repository folders whose file lists are included, e.g. `["~/code/shared-lib"]`.

axiora.docs.maxPages.markdownDescription: Maximum pages crawled for each documentation source added with **Docs: Add Documentation...**.

axiora.memory.enabled.markdownDescription: Include `.axiora/memory.md` in every `@axiora` prompt. Add notes with `/remember` or **Axiora AI: Add to Memory...**.

axiora.chat.maxContextTokens.markdownDescription: When a conversation grows past this many (estimated) tokens, older turns are summarized automatically so the chat keeps going.

axiora.chat.seriesLimit.markdownDescription: Messages per conversation part (yours and Axiora's together). When a part fills up, Axiora quietly continues in the next part — e.g. **Project 1 → Project 2** — carrying a summary forward so nothing is lost. Browse all parts with **Axiora: Past Conversations**. `0` turns this off.

axiora.checkpoints.autoOnSave.markdownDescription: Create a checkpoint automatically when you save (at most every 5 minutes). Restore with **Axiora AI: Restore Checkpoint...**.

axiora.lintFix.onSave.markdownDescription: After saving, let the AI fix the errors left in the file, re-checking until it is clean or `#axiora.lintFix.maxIterations#` is reached.

axiora.solo.testCommand.markdownDescription: Command `/solo` runs to verify its work, e.g. `npm test`, `pytest -q` or `cargo test`. Empty uses `npm test` when `package.json` has a test script.

axiora.solo.maxIterations.markdownDescription: How many write-test-fix rounds `/solo` may run before stopping.

enumDescriptions: Runs the right passes automatically (recommended).
Classic pdfLaTeX, single pass.
Unicode and system fonts.
Unicode, system fonts and Lua scripting.
Self-contained engine that downloads packages on demand.

axiora.latex.buildOnSave.markdownDescription: Rebuild the PDF whenever you save while its preview is open.

axiora.latex.viewerDpi.markdownDescription: Render resolution (DPI) of the SyncTeX PDF preview. Higher is sharper but slower.

axiora.container.engine.markdownDescription: Container engine for container debugging and runner isolation.
enumDescriptions: Docker Engine or Docker Desktop.
Daemonless, rootless Podman.

axiora.wasi.replace.markdownDescription: When a WASI plugin runs on the document or selection, replace it with the output. Turn off to open the output in a new tab instead.

enumDescriptions: Confirm deletes, pushes, destructive commands, deploys and sends (recommended).
Confirm every agent action, including file writes and safe commands.
Confirm only high-risk actions such as force-push, recursive delete, deploys and sends.
axiora.approval.mode.markdownDescription: When to ask before the agent does something destructive or visible to others — deleting files, `git push`, risky shell commands, deploys, and sending messages (sends always ask). Change quickly with **Axiora AI: Set Approval Mode...**.

axiora.security.scanOnSave.markdownDescription: Scan files for leaked secrets and insecure code when you open or save them. Findings appear in the **Problems** panel.

axiora.sandbox.engine.markdownDescription: Isolation used by **Run Current File in Sandbox**.
enumDescriptions: JavaScript only: no child processes or workers, file reads limited to the workspace, writes to `.axiora/sandbox-out`.
Any language in a container with no network and a read-only workspace.
Same as Docker, using Podman.

axiora.policy.url.markdownDescription: Optional JSON policy (`{"exclude": [...], "redact": [...]}`) served from your own server. Merged with `.axiora/policy.json` to keep files and secrets out of AI requests.

axiora.sync.endpoint.markdownDescription: Your own settings-sync server, e.g. `https://sync.example.com/api/sync`. Leave empty to turn sync off. Set the token with **Axiora Sync: Set Token...**.

axiora.dotfiles.repository.markdownDescription: Your dotfiles: a Git URL, `owner/repo` on GitHub, or a local folder.

axiora.dotfiles.targetPath.markdownDescription: Folder the repository is cloned into.

axiora.dotfiles.installCommand.markdownDescription: Command run after cloning. Empty runs `install.sh`, `bootstrap.sh` or `setup.sh` (`install.ps1` on Windows), otherwise links the dotfiles into your home folder.

axiora.dotfiles.installOnStartup.markdownDescription: Pull and apply your dotfiles every time the editor starts.

axiora.dotfiles.ignore.markdownDescription: Files that are never linked into your home folder, e.g. `[".gitconfig"]`.

axiora.agent.keepAwake.markdownDescription: Prevent the computer from sleeping while `@axiora`, `/solo` or background tasks are running.

axiora.ai.apiKey.markdownDescription:
**One key is all you need.** Paste a key and Axiora detects the provider, picks a good model for chat and inline suggestions, and tests it.

`sk-or-…` OpenRouter · `gsk_…` Groq · `AIza…` Gemini · `sk-ant-…` Anthropic · `sk-…` OpenAI

The key is kept in the OS keychain — never in `settings.json`. Image, voice and speech use this key unless you set their own. Also in **Axiora: Set Up AI** and [Connected Services](command:axiora.services.open).

axiora.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Where models run. Set the API key with **Axiora AI: Set API Key...** (stored in the OS keychain) and check it with **Axiora AI: Test Model Connection**.
enumDescriptions: Models on your machine through Ollama — private and free.
Any OpenAI-compatible server: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Groq, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM…

axiora.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Server address.

- Ollama: `http://127.0.0.1:11434`
- OpenRouter: `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`
- OpenAI: `https://api.openai.com/v1`
- LM Studio: `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1`

axiora.ai.chatModel.markdownDescription: Model for `@axiora` chat, `/review`, `/spec` and the agents. Inline suggestions use `#axiora.inlineCompletion.model#`.

axiora.ai.router.enabled.markdownDescription: Pick a model per request: short, simple prompts go to `#axiora.ai.router.smallModel#`, long or complex ones to `#axiora.ai.router.largeModel#`.

axiora.ai.router.smallModel.markdownDescription: Fast, cheap model for short questions, e.g. `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b`.

axiora.ai.router.largeModel.markdownDescription: Strong model for refactors, debugging, design and long code.

axiora.ai.router.threshold.markdownDescription: Prompt size in characters above which the large model is used.

axiora.ai.costPer1kInputTokens.markdownDescription: Used by **Axiora AI: Show Usage** to estimate spend. Use `0` for local models.

axiora.ai.visionModel.markdownDescription: Model that accepts images, used for screenshot-to-UI and computer use, e.g. `qwen2.5vl` or `llava`. Empty uses the chat model.

axiora.ai.embeddingModel.markdownDescription: Embedding model for the semantic code index, e.g. `nomic-embed-text`. Falls back to local hashed vectors when unavailable.

axiora.image.model.markdownDescription: Model used by `/image`. OpenRouter: an image-output model such as `google/gemini-2.5-flash-image`. OpenAI: `gpt-image-1`. Set a separate key with **Image: Set Image API Key...**.

enumDescriptions: OpenRouter uses chat with image output; everything else uses `/images/generations`.
Chat completions with `modalities: ["image", "text"]`.
The OpenAI-style `/images/generations` endpoint.

axiora.image.folder.markdownDescription: Folder, relative to the workspace, where generated images are saved.

axiora.arena.models.markdownDescription: Models compared side by side in `/arena`, e.g. `["qwen2.5-coder:7b", "llama3.1:8b"]`. Empty uses every available model.

axiora.voice.provider.markdownDescription: Where dictation is transcribed. Start dictation with **Voice: Dictate**.
enumDescriptions: A whisper.cpp server on your machine (`#axiora.voice.endpoint#`) — private and offline.
Groq, OpenAI or any `/audio/transcriptions` endpoint (`#axiora.voice.baseUrl#`). Set the key with **Voice: Set Speech-to-Text API Key...**.

axiora.voice.endpoint.markdownDescription:
whisper.cpp server URL, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8080/inference`.

Start one with `whisper-server -m ggml-base.en.bin --port 8080`.

axiora.voice.model.markdownDescription: Transcription model. Empty uses `whisper-1` locally and `whisper-large-v3-turbo` online.

axiora.voice.tts.provider.markdownDescription: Voice used by the **Read aloud** button under chat replies.
enumDescriptions: Windows speech, macOS `say`, or Linux `spd-say`/`espeak-ng` — offline and free.
An `/audio/speech` endpoint such as OpenAI. Set the key with **Voice: Set Text-to-Speech API Key...**.

axiora.voice.tts.autoSpeak.markdownDescription: Read every `@axiora` reply aloud as soon as it finishes. Stop with **Voice: Stop Speaking**.

axiora.voice.tts.rate.markdownDescription: Speaking speed from `-10` (slowest) to `10` (fastest). `0` is normal.

axiora.voice.tts.osVoice.markdownDescription: Name of an installed system voice, e.g. `Microsoft Zira Desktop` (Windows) or `Samantha` (macOS). Empty uses the default.

axiora.voice.tts.model.markdownDescription: Model for the OpenAI-compatible provider, e.g. `gpt-4o-mini-tts` or `tts-1`.

axiora.voice.tts.voice.markdownDescription: Voice for the OpenAI-compatible provider, e.g. `alloy`, `nova` or `verse`.

axiora.connectors.jira.token.markdownDescription: Paste an [Atlassian API token](https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens). Needs `#axiora.connectors.jira.site#` and `#axiora.connectors.jira.email#` too — or connect everything at once in [Connected Services](command:axiora.services.open).

axiora.connectors.jira.site.markdownDescription: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. `https://acme.atlassian.net`. Add the API token with **Connectors: Manage...**.

axiora.connectors.jira.email.markdownDescription: Atlassian account email that owns the API token.

axiora.google.account.markdownDescription: Sign in with your Google account for Gmail, Drive and Calendar. Uses your own OAuth client from `#axiora.google.clientId#`.

axiora.google.clientId.markdownDescription: Your own Google OAuth client (type **Desktop app**) for Gmail, Drive and Calendar. Create it in the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials), then run **Google: Sign In...** — the client secret is kept in the OS keychain.

axiora.connectors.figma.token.markdownDescription: Paste a [Figma personal access token](https://www.figma.com/developers/api#access-tokens) (read-only *File content* scope is enough). Use `/figma <file-url>` in chat.

axiora.connectors.slack.token.markdownDescription: Paste a [Slack bot or user token](https://api.slack.com/apps) (`xoxb-…` or `xoxp-…`). Stored for Slack-aware agent tools.

axiora.connectors.linear.token.markdownDescription: Paste a [Linear personal API key](https://linear.app/settings/account/security) (`lin_api_…`). Use `/linear` in chat.

axiora.connectors.stripe.token.markdownDescription: Paste a [Stripe restricted key](https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys) (`rk_…`, read-only recommended). Use `/stripe` in chat.

axiora.github.token.markdownDescription: Sign in with GitHub, or paste a [fine-grained token](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens). Public repos work without one.

axiora.github.repo.markdownDescription: Repository as `owner/name`. Empty uses the `origin` remote of the open folder.

axiora.mcpServer.enabled.markdownDescription: Expose this editor as an MCP server on `127.0.0.1`, so external agents can read open editors, the selection, files and diagnostics. Copy the client config with **MCP: Copy Server Config**.

axiora.mcpServer.port.markdownDescription: Local port for the MCP server.

axiora.mcpServer.allowWrites.markdownDescription: Let MCP clients change files through the editor. Off keeps the server read-only.

axiora.browser.executablePath.markdownDescription: Chrome, Edge or Chromium used by the agent browser. Empty detects an installed one automatically.

axiora.browser.headless.markdownDescription: Run the agent browser without showing its window.

axiora.browser.maxSteps.markdownDescription: Most actions **Browser: Run Task...** may take before stopping.

axiora.runner.machines.markdownDescription: Self-hosted runners (`bin/axiora-runner.mjs`) that take agent tasks, e.g. `[{"name": "build-box", "url": "http://10.0.0.5:7788"}]`. Tokens are kept in the OS keychain.

axiora.collab.relayUrl.markdownDescription: Your self-hosted relay for live collaboration (`node bin/axiora-relay.mjs`). Messages are end-to-end encrypted; the relay sees only ciphertext.

axiora.share.endpoint.markdownDescription: Server that publishes shared chats: receives `POST {title, markdown, html}` and returns `{url}`.

axiora.embed.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Public address where you host `.axiora/embeds`; used in copied iframe snippets.

axiora.acp.agents.markdownDescription: External agents spoken to over the Agent Client Protocol, e.g. `[{"name": "gemini", "command": "gemini", "args": ["--experimental-acp"]}]`.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_web_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the web. Returns titles, URLs, snippets.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_web_fetch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a URL and return its readable text (article/main content) and links.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_browser
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Drive a real browser. action: goto(url) | click(n|selector|text) | fill(n|selector|text, value) | press(key) | select | check | back | text | snapshot | screenshot | assert(text) | close. Returns numbered interactive elements.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_browser_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Give a multi-step goal to the browser agent (it navigates, clicks, fills forms) and get the result + final screenshot.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_make_document
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create an office file. kind: xlsx|docx|pptx|pdf. spec: {title, blocks:[{heading}|{text}|{bullets:[]}|{table:[[...]]}|{chart:{type,title,labels,series:[{name,values}]}}|{image}], sheets:[{name,rows}], slides:[{title,bullets,chart,image,notes}]}

languageModelTools.name: axiora_make_chart
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Render a chart to PNG + SVG. chart: {type:bar|line|pie, title, labels:[], series:[{name, values:[]}]}

languageModelTools.name: axiora_generate_image
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate an image from a text prompt; saved in the project.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_screenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Capture the editor window (or whole screen) and show it in chat.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_draft_message
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Prepare an email (gmail) or Slack message as a DRAFT card. It is never sent automatically; the user reviews and clicks Send.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_run_shell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in the workspace (destructive commands need user approval).

languageModelTools.name: axiora_delete_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete a file in the workspace (requires user approval).
